LM18-G06.name: Godzilla (2016) Fourth Form
LM18-G06.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Shin-Godzilla (Fourth Form)".

Flash- [Change: Cost 7 ([Red Core][Red Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing 30000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 6 or more "Godzilla" Spirit with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By discarding a card from your Hand, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

LM18-G02.name: Godzilla (vs King Ghidorah)
LM18-G02.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Also, if you control another "Godzilla"/"Ghidorah"-named Spirit, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2]
All your "Godzilla"/"Ghidorah"-named Spirits can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

LM18-G01.name: Godzilla (vs Mothra)
LM18-G01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Green.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Godzilla"/"Mothra" Spirit attacks, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

LM18-G05.name: Godzilla (✕ MechaGodzilla)
LM18-G05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "Godzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu" Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. When this effect adds any Spirit card to the Hand, discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Godzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu" Spirits are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Ultimate effects.

LM18-G07.name: Unmanned Train Bomb
LM18-G07.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 12000 BP. Or, heavy exhaust an opposing "Shin-Godzilla"-named Spirit. This heavy exhausting effect can't be prevented by any effect.
[heb]
